English: Spirit Post
A simple wooden post adorned with feathers and animal bones, serving as the earliest marker of shamanic presence and a gathering point for the clans spiritual guidance.
Bone Rattle Hut
A hide-draped lean-to where the shaman crafts bone rattles and fetishes, used to commune with spirits and bolster the unity of the clan during hardship.
Drum Circle
A communal area ringed with logs and drums, where rhythmic ceremonies reinforce tribal bonds and lend spiritual strength to the horde.
Sacred Fire Tent
A central tent housing the eternal sacred fire. Here, the shaman leads rituals believed to protect the people and ensure the favor of ancestral spirits.
Ancestor Shelter
A larger, sturdier structure built of timber and earth, housing relics of revered ancestors and serving as a sanctuary for sacred rites.
Totem Pavilion
A great tent adorned with carved wooden totems, each representing a spirit guardian. The pavilion is a center of ceremonies and clan deliberations.
Vision Yurt
A large, ornate yurt used for trance rituals and divination, where the high shaman seeks visions for the future of the clan and the horde.
Seers Room
A private, sanctified chamber within the vision yurt, reserved for the most potent and secretive rituals. Only the most trusted shamans may enter.
Spirit Chamber
A hidden, fortified chamber where the shaman communes with the most powerful spirits to secure the favor of the unseen world for the entire horde.
High Shaman Camp
An expansive complex of tents, shelters, and sacred spaces serving as the heart of the clans spiritual life, unifying the horde under the wisdom and power of the High Shaman.
